text: Armed men broke into our house at night, tied us up and took our jewellery.
My husband hit me and then threatened to post my private photos online if I told anyone.
A fake bank agent called, got my OTP and moved money out of my account.
A fake crypto investment site promised returns and then blocked my withdrawal.
A mob beat a man accused of theft and set his shop on fire.
A teenage girl was tricked online into sending photos and is now being blackmailed for money.
A gang member shot a shopkeeper who refused to pay protection money.
A manager sent me explicit messages and touched my shoulder in the lift.
A group of men attacked a couple leaving a restaurant, shouting insults about their religion.
An employee deleted the company's database after being fired.
Thieves broke into a pharmacy and took opioid pills.
A clinic charged my insurance for treatments I never had and the doctor had a fake licence.
A group snatched a woman's chain and beat her when she resisted.
A man followed his ex-wife and then slashed her tyres.
A contractor took our advance and used cheap material, then threatened us when we complained.
